model.name: AERONAUT 通用双发民航客机
model.kind: Original parametric exterior concept, not a specific certified aircraft type
model.author: AERONAUT project — original geometry authored with OpenAI Codex assistance
model.upstream: No third-party model, airline trademarks or image textures used
model.modificationRights: Copy, modify, redistribute and use commercially under CC0; no attribution condition. Original source is included.

orientation.positiveX: aircraft left when facing the nose from the cockpit

model.optimization: Lossless vertex welding, resource deduplication and pruning. Geometry batched by semantic part/material. No texture maps, Draco, WASM decoder or runtime CDN.
limitations: Conceptual exterior only; no OEM accuracy claim
No cabin or internal systems geometry
Landing gear is static, with separate nodes but no rig or animation
